{{SupportPage|vendor=Linksys|model=WUSB11}} This device appears to be identical to the [[Linksys WUSB11 v2.0]] besides the FCC grantee code change to PKW. "3741-02000110" or something similar is silkscreened on the PCB in the FCC photos. FCC ID O7JGL2411USB ([[Global Sun GL2411IU]]) shows a casing very similar to the WUSB11 v1/v2 casing (with WUSB11 labeling), however, this model does not appear to have been marketed (it was also an Atmel 503A + Intersil 3861 unit)
